items.title: David Weiss interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2022
items.q: I wound up writing a couple of big band charts for another Wayne Shorter project that Wallace Roney was doing.

ctx.x: Yeah I was just thinking that.

Yeah well it’s a problem. And it’s a problem to get around. So octet, I mean for this Wayne Shorter thing I did eight horns and I thought that was about as much as I’d ever need without having to change the mindset completely into a big band thing, which I think is a whole other thing. I wound up writing a couple of big band charts for another Wayne Shorter project that Wallace Roney was doing. And it wasn’t — I guess one chart I actually had to arrange it, the others were just kind of re-orchestrating some…
